metadata.title: Clicked like I owed them a soda and got 1 baffling kill? Valorant aim is broken again
metadata.description:
Clicked like my mouse was possessed.
Enemy probably questioning reality.
Pretending that was skill for a hot 0.13 seconds.
Click if your aim’s a glorious mess but kills still sneak in!

Tap if your aim’s a glorious disaster but the game still says yes!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
